status.en: 26 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Damascus, Quneitra and Golan Heights.
status.nb: 26 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Damaskus, Quneitra og Golanhøydene.

summary.en: Jordan has launched airstrikes and ground attacks against militants in southern Syria, citing retaliation for a deadly church attack that killed nine people. Syrian authorities have imposed new restrictions on women, banning them from university courses and limiting admission to security-focused universities, while a delegation from the Interior Ministry attended a security university graduation in Riyadh. A car bomb on the Damascus-Homs highway killed several people, and a separate drone strike on the same highway killed three individuals, according to defense sources. Additionally, a target linked to Abu Abdul Rahman al-Libi was reportedly engaged near Qara in Syria.
summary.nb: Jordan har igangsatt luftangrep og bakkekamp mot militante i sørlige Syria, og hevder at dette er gjengjeldelse for et dødelig kirkearrest som drepte ni personer. Syriske myndigheter har innført nye restriksjoner på kvinner, forbyr dem fra universitetsstudier og begrenser opptak til sikkerhetsfokuserte universiteter, mens en delegasjon fra Innenministeriet deltok på en sikkerhetsuniversitetsutdeling i Riyadh. En bilbombe på motorveien Damascus-Homs drepte flere personer, og et separat droneredskap på samme vei drepte tre personer, ifølge forsvarskilder. I tillegg ble et mål knyttet til Abu Abdul Rahman al-Libi angrepet nær Qara i Syria.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
